query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS reverse_engineering_analyses (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  organization_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  competitor_product_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  user_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  analysis_type ENUM('performance_translation', 'formulation_strategy', 'tpp_generation', 'cost_analysis', 'regulatory_comparison') NOT NULL,
  input_data JSON NOT NULL,
  results JSON NOT NULL,
  recommendations JSON,
  alternative_materials JSON,
  estimated_cost DECIMAL(10,2),
  feasibility_score DECIMAL(5,2),
  llm_model_used VARCHAR(255),
  tokens_used INT,
  cost_usd DECIMAL(10,4),
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  FOREIGN KEY (organization_id) REFERENCES organizations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (competitor_product_id) REFERENCES competitor_products(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id),
  INDEX idx_re_analyses_org (organization_id),
  INDEX idx_re_analyses_product (competitor_product_id)
);
